The '''Spice Shippers Fellowship''' was a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] guild. It was declared illegal by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Norrin]] and its guild hall was raided by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.
